entities.summary: Salina Turda is a underground experience destination in Turda, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: A spectacular salt mine whose huge underground chambers contain unusual recreation installations and dramatic industrial spaces. This entry is intended for 6–adult travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.
